aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact deterministic transformation, no timing comparison.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Wrong source SHA is a deterministic refusal condition; no statistical null population applies.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Deterministic small unsafe-unit and missing-unit kernel fixtures are software controls, not a positive population arm.

decision_rule.text: Accept a sliced D4 seed only on independent C0-C3 checker success; report exact rebased border and source-derived admission separately.
decision_rule.threshold: valid_affine_slice_nonmembership and valid triangular profile with border <=103156 for 64 GiB screen

placement.checkpoint_detail: One projection, one rebase, one checker, one profile; no checkpoint or automatic retry. Preserve partial and failure outputs.

inadmissible: Inferring a D5 or LFD-six bound from this D4 transformation.
Calling a projected or rebased map accepted before the independent checker.
Treating an optimistic original-border screen as the actual sliced border.
Retrying the one-attempt run under another name without a new protocol.
invalidation_rules: Any source or binary hash mismatch prevents execution.
A failed independent checker prevents a claim from that stage.
A counter failure prevents a solution-count comparison.
Killing1 in an over-approximating quotient is not membership evidence in the true closure.
Missing later stages remain unknown, even if an earlier stage proves a smaller lower bound.
Deferred export or missing checkpoint/certificate carries no mathematical bound.
Restore request mismatch or unverified state prevents native launch.
